description: Shared layout shell for linear signing steps.

parameters.name: AppearsOn
parameters.description: Optional HTML id applied to the validation message for aria-describedby links.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Short text describing where the field appears in the document.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Optional description rendered below the label.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Explicit label overriding the field title or name.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve field labels and descriptions.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Signing field represented by this step.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when the requested culture is missing.

parameters.name: ValidationMessage
parameters.description: Whether the step is required. Defaults to the field requirement.

parameters.name: ValidationMessageId
parameters.description: Validation message shown below the step content.
